# llms.txt — https://csoai.org
# Council of AI (CSOAI LTD, UK 16939677)
# Independent measurement body for AI behaviour.
# We measure, sign, and re-attest. Everyone can check.
# Verified measurement credential — never certification. Not a notified body.

## Canonical surfaces
- [Home](https://csoai.org): measurement body landing
- [Council site](https://councilof.ai): the human application
- [Signed scoreboard](https://councilof.ai/gspc-scoreboard)
- [Verify](https://councilof.ai/verify): free, loginless, client-side
- [Arena](https://csoai.org/arenas): measured AI-vs-AI spectator
- [GSPC API](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): live axis register (cite totals.public_count — currently 14 measured of 14 quotable)
- [Latest signed receipt](https://csoai.org/api/receipts/latest): one full signed receipt + offline verify steps
- [DID](https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json): the trust root (Ed25519)
- [Agent card](https://councilof.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A card
- [MCP registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io): io.github.CSOAI-ORG/gspc 1.0.3+

## How to verify (no login)
1. Fetch a signed artifact (receipt / board / card).
2. Recreate the content_id (RFC 8785 canonical JSON → SHA-256).
3. Verify Ed25519 against the public key in did:web:csoai.org.

## Honesty rules
- Measurement, not certification. Never a conformity mark.
- Quotable board = **14** axes. Do not invent 22.
- Cite live `totals.public_count` — never freeze axis counts in this file.
- Legacy internal codenames are not public chrome; historical counts in old caches are superseded by the signed manifest.
